item.title: Inwai na Shinryakusha
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Dog Rolled Egger
  • 発売日: 2024-12-22
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: 淫猥な侵略者
  • 英語名: Inwai na Shinryakusha

あらすじ

At first there was a squirrel. To be precise, it is a deformed squirrel-like creature. The squirrel clung to the strange creature and shook its hips in a frenzy.

After a few years, the squirrels disappeared from the forest.

This time it was rabbits and then domestic sheep, and the incident gradually expanded in scale.

あらすじ

The protagonist goes to gather medicinal herbs to cure his mother’s illness, but he ends up lost in the world of succubi.

Will he be able to return safely to his original world without being corrupted by succubi?
